source_2021_locator: The audited settlement source_record_id ends with the 1-based Parquet row; DuckDB file_row_number is 0-based and was replayed against the raw parquet.
scope: Full exact 1847 current source-ID cohort from frozen point-conflict audit. Corrected row counts are 862 old GeoKLADR point/source rows (2010: 822, 2002: 40) across 824 current source IDs, after requiring unique single P625, accepted current Dadata/GeoNames agreement ≤1km, old same-graph GeoKLADR >20km away, and no event candidates. This supersedes the initial rough 994 diagnostic.
limitations: Candidate rows only; no accepted point or identity mutation.
Current source point and Wikidata P625 are two distinct source families but P625 may be imported/secondary.
Current QID binding predicate vector is a candidate evidence gate, not a separate independent historical identity review.
No historical coordinates are asserted or synthesized from census dates.
